attacks.name: Shield Throw
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
This attack ignores LOS, and the defender does not benefit from Cover.
After this attack is resolved, if it dealt |!damage| and the defender is |!size| 2 or less, this character may Push it Away |!range_small|.

|!wild| |*Ricochet|: After this attack is resolved, this character may make an additional |*Shield Throw| attack. This attack must target another character within |!range| 3 of the original defender and may be any distance from this character. This additional attack does not have the |*Ricochet| special rule.

attacks.name: Redwing Assault
steps: After this attack is resolved, if it dealt |!damage| and the defender is |!size| 3 or less, this character may Throw it Away |!range_small|.
After this attack is resolved, place this character within |!range| 2 of its current position.

superPowers.name: All New, All Different (Affiliation: Avengers)
superPowers.body: When an allied non-Grunt character is Dazed or KO'd by an enemy effect, choose another non-Dazed allied character. After the effect is resolved, the chosen character removes 1 |!damage|, removes 1 special condition, and may advance |!range_small|. A character can be affected by this Leadership ability only once per Round.

superPowers.name: Charge
superPowers.body: |*Action|: This character immediately makes a move action followed by an attack action. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Air Lift
superPowers.body: During its Activation, when this character begins a move action within |!range| 2 of another allied character of Size 2 or less, it may use this superpower. After this move action is resolved, Place that allied character within |!range| 2 of its current position. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Vibranium Shield
superPowers.body: When this character is targeted by a |!physical| or |!energy| attack, it may use this superpower. Add 2 dice to this character's defense roll against that attack.
